thesis: The podcast argues that having a self-transcending purpose or 'why' acts as a psychological compass that improves performance by reducing fear responses in the brain when facing challenges. This concept is supported by fMRI research showing that individuals primed with core values do not exhibit the same fear activation as those without such a guiding principle, allowing them to push through distressing situations.
